checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes within pipette ranges (multi splits 500 into 2×250? split gives ≤200 each), no well overfilled, simulator passed and tempdeck set to 4 C.
Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips); p1000 fresh tip per sample, multi fresh tip per column for removals/elution/recovery, every path ends with drop_tip.
Recovers the full 100 µL eluate (m300.aspirate(ELUTION_VOL...) in step 9) rather than ~80 µL, and adds an unspecified 10× bead-resuspension mix/bead pre-mixes, so not fully faithful.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed; tubes mapped one-to-one to wells in columns 1,3,...,11 and eluates to same-position elution wells (distinct_elution_wells passed).
Beads 40, isopropanol 250, sample 250 in order, p1000.mix(5,...), 5 min delay, magdeck.engage then 4 min delay, then 540 µL removed to waste with magnet on (all checks passed).
Two 500 µL ethanol washes each removed with magnet engaged, 4 min delay, magdeck.disengage() before elution; checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.
Elution recovery aspirates 100 µL (ELUTION_VOL) from the 100 µL elution rather than about 80 µL, risking bead carryover and deviating from the ~80 µL specification.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all measured checks and handles binding, washes, drying and tips correctly. It recovers the full 100 µL of eluate instead of about 80 µL, so elution_recovery and fidelity fail.
